Dragon Quest is a series that has become synomous within JRPG and gaming as a whole, and Square Enix is gearing up to release a reimagined version of one of their best sellers.


Dragon Quest VII (7) was originally released back in 2000, and we're soon going to be diving into a brand new iteration of the game.


Here's what we know about what platforms it'll be playable on.


## Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined Platforms: What We Know, Cross-Save and More


Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined is a title that many long-time fans of the series have been anticipating for, and for those who didn't have the chance to play the game back in 2000, this will be a fantastic chance too.


Square Enix has been marketing the game extensively in the lead-up to it's release, and the game will be playable on the following platforms:


- Nintendo Switch
- Nintendo Switch 2
- Xbox Series X|S
- PlayStation 5
- PC
